scan_log.reason: Broke to a fresh high near $41.47 on rising volume, but the next bar failed to hold above that high and volume dropped off; price slipped back under $41 the bar after that.
Still bouncing in the same $13.20-$13.66 band it's held all morning, no clean break either direction.
Opening dip already faded into a tight $101-$102 chop with volume drying up through the morning.
Tried twice to break above $9.90 and rolled over both times; the last two bars turned lower on fading volume.
Faded steadily off this morning's high near $19.14, volume shrinking the whole way down; no news explains the reversal despite strength elsewhere in the sector.
Made a fresh session low on above-average volume, but the next bar bounced back up through most of that range before closing lower again.
Similar drift lower, but volume on the attempted breakdown bar came in below the recent average.
Volume too thin for the stock's size; a normal stop would land inside the bid/ask spread.
Inching higher along with the broader oil-price jump, but volume kept shrinking bar to bar.
Chopped sideways through the first 20 minutes of the session with no real move either way.

news.title: US strikes Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: First US military action in the region in about a month sent oil sharply higher into Monday's open, with WTI up 3-4% toward the mid-$86s and Brent above $91.

news.title: Energy names lead premarket gains on the oil spike
news.summary: Halliburton, Chevron, Valero, Occidental and Exxon all traded higher premarket as crude jumped on the weekend's Middle East escalation.

news.title: PG&E slides after lawmakers amend wildfire-liability bill
news.summary: California's SB 492 wildfire-liability legislation was amended in a way PG&E called critical to its financing framework, sending the utility down sharply. Utilities broadly traded under pressure.

news.title: Residual hawkishness from Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech
news.summary: Markets are still digesting Friday's address, in which Warsh said elevated prices need to stay the Fed's main focus and described financial conditions as not broadly restrictive. The 10-year yield is holding near 4.72%, little moved since Friday's jump.

news.title: ONEOK to acquire Brazos Midstream for $4.425B
news.summary: The cash deal for Permian Midland Basin gas gathering and processing assets is funded by $9B in non-voting minority equity from Apollo, aimed at debt paydown and growth. Expected to close in Q4.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ether stabilize after the weekend pullback
news.summary: BTC and ETH both traded modestly higher Monday morning, roughly flat to up versus their weekend lows, with the broader crypto-proxy basket showing some divergence from spot as the session gets underway.

news.title: SEC custody rulemaking still moving through White House review
news.summary: The SEC's 'Regulation Crypto Assets' custody proposal, part of the broader safe-harbor package released in mid-August, remains in OIRA review with no market reaction tied to it yet.
